Where Redfin Partner Agents shines

Most common complaint

Partner agents aren't Redfin employees; you don't choose.

Is Redfin Partner Agents free?

Yes for consumers — the agent pays Redfin Partner Agents a referral fee (~30% reported). Money Move Homes is also free; our partner agents pay 25%, disclosed up front.

What's the best Redfin Partner Agents alternative?

If you want to choose your one agent from a published scorecard and keep your number private, Money Move Homes was built for that. If you need a fast cash sale, an iBuyer may fit better — we'll tell you honestly.

Does Redfin Partner Agents sell my information?

Check their privacy policy and consent screen for "marketing partners." Common complaint: partner agents aren't redfin employees; you don't choose. Money Move Homes shares your info only with the one agent you choose.
